title: Spec notes from wiring the WSS extensions (chat/vtc/scene-wss)
description: From JMAP-sldb: (1) chat-wss typing rate limit drops everything over 1 per 3 s with no latest-on-reopen clause, so typing:false soon after typing:true is lost; (2) whether outbound limits count per recipient connection or per user (interaction limit says per user); (3) VTCRingEvent / VTCCallEndEvent recipients: nothing in the event names the callee; (4) chat event accountId is the recipient's account, implying per-recipient fan-out; (5) what a SceneInteractionEvent frame may carry and whether a malformed frame gets notRequest; (6) observe breaks the 'scene' alias superset assumption for the union (handle in JMAP-24aw); (7) credential expiry cannot be enforced inside a stream handler. Mark's call (jmap-chat-spec); draft a patch for review.
notes: 2026-11-21 from JMAP-24aw (scene-00/scene-wss-00 at 93f2258): (8) regionIds 'matches in every account' doesn't say which accounts an observe check looks in (impl: observer_accounts hook, default own account); (9) whether delivery resumes for existing observers when allowObservers goes false->true (impl: checked per event, resumes); (10) whether a policy decline applies at delivery as well as enable (impl: both); (11) when observerCount is recomputed after access changes; (12) SHOULD NOT hide avatars from owner/admins left to backend; (13) empty broadcast 'event' refused with invalidProperties; (14) absent data reads as null.
close_reason: Decision 66: spec patches committed as jmap-chat-spec 42aed85 (chat-wss, vtc-wss, scene-00, scene-wss, guides) and the typing:false exemption end to end (chat-00, chat-federation-00); chat-server delivers typing:false outside the limit (46b7abf1). Code follow-ups JMAP-ypwe, JMAP-1mep.
